what: liveness gate, pooled effect and power for block 7 (same loop-free arm, gate calibrated to the observed rate)
arm: Y = R with the cap reserved for edges no loop asserts; loop-asserted edges admitted only as backfill

changed_from_block6.G0: 96/100, which the calibration's own liveness (6/10) could not reach -> 50/100, calibrated to the pooled rate 0.618
changed_from_block6.unchanged: arm Y, world, cap 20, readout, C1' band, G2 bar, M1 bar 0.01, M2 novel bar 0.005, C/R baselines

block6.why: block 6 was void by its own gate, so its cells are not being judged by block 7; rule 19 permits re-calibration on data that is not being judged

liveness.bar_rule: at least half the seeds, a bar the pooled rate clears with the probability below; it is reachable by construction, which 96/100 was not

bar.provenance: unchanged from block 6: one fifth of R's gain over C on block 5's 100 fresh seeds, so blocks 6 and 7 test the same claim at the same bar

power_note: at the unchanged bar 0.01 the pooled mean 0.01 sits -0.01 standard errors from it, so this block is underpowered at M1 and a miss does not distinguish 'no effect' from 'smaller than 0.01'; a pass would be informative
caveat: the pooled sd is dominated by block 6's void cells, which is the best estimate available and still a single draw of 110; the block reports its own observed mean and interval beside the bar
